## Scope of attribution

The adapted workshop flow covers RDF/OWL ontology and graph setup, ontology-grounded document retrieval and Select AI agent/tool scenarios. These patterns inform this project's SQL lab sequence and agent workflow. The knowledge/context dataset, learner scenarios and explorer experience are the project's adaptation; the original Formula 1 dataset is not included as learning content. This is workflow-level provenance, not a claim that every SQL file was copied verbatim.

Any retained or adapted upstream material remains subject to its applicable UPL terms and Oracle attribution. The root MIT licence applies to Jason Lowe's original contributions and does not replace upstream notices or claim ownership of Oracle material. Include this attribution, the retained UPL notice and the root NOTICE when redistributing substantial upstream-derived material, including it within a separately distributed export or installer where applicable.

This is an independent educational project, not an official Oracle LiveLabs release. Oracle product names and trademarks remain with their respective owners.
